subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Illusion of Authority
description: A 60-second lesson on The Illusion of Authority.

hook.text: A man in a security uniform tells you to hand over your laptop. Most people comply without question.

buildup.text: Uniforms, titles, and official-sounding language trigger automatic obedience.

discovery.text: Stanley Milgram's experiments showed people follow authority figures even when it feels wrong.

twist.text: Con artists exploit this by wearing suits, flashing badges, and using corporate jargon.

climax.text: We're trained from childhood to respect authority — and scammers weaponize that training.

punchline.text: A uniform is just a costume with better branding.

quiz.question: What psychological principle do con artists exploit with uniforms and titles?
